notes.title: Where have I've been?
notes.notes:
Hello!

You may or may not know about this. I didn't upload or posted any updates for this game. The simplest reason I can think of is im busy with school and living life. Through out the year I've learnt a lot about coding, marketing strategies. As well I'm learning how to make unreal engine 5 games.

In a couple weeks you can will see some changes as I'm rebranding Dr.Pumpkin to "The werewolf hunt". In the name of the title you just hunt a werewolf and multiplayer will be included 


What will happen to the dlc I've bought? (They are trash tbh)

No, you will not get a refund instead I'll simply rename and change the dlc store page. 
I'll be adding maps for irl money and skins. I promise not to make them overpriced. This money would pay off my debt to realse this game into steam. If you want to support me feel free to leave a positive review even if you don't like my game <3 (donations are appreciated but you dont need to)

Email support: bngo590@gmail.com 

Thank you for reading!
